verdict.rationale: Salv is an API-driven compliance SaaS with public developer docs, so shipping an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions either. The downloadable OpenAPI definition is offered for importing into Postman, which makes it a general API artifact rather than agent-oriented documentation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
